remarks:
Located in the Town of Orchard Park, just off Southwestern Boulevard on a quiet, private loop street, this impeccably maintained Ranch offers the perfect combination of peaceful neighborhood living and everyday convenience. Set on over 1/3 of an acre, the home features a spacious, functional floor plan highlighted by pristine natural white oak hardwood flooring throughout. The large living room provides plenty of space to relax and entertain, while the generous kitchen offers abundant workspace along with a comfortable breakfast nook. An adjacent formal dining room provides additional space for meals and gatherings.

Three generous bedrooms include a primary bedroom with its own en-suite half bath, while the full bath conveniently serves the remainder of the home. One of the advantages of a sprawling Ranch is the equally impressive basement below, and this home delivers with a large, clean and dry space offering tremendous potential for additional living or recreation space, a workshop, hobby or craft area, home gym, or simply exceptional storage.

An attached 2-car garage keeps your vehicles protected from Western New York weather, while the triple-wide driveway provides plenty of additional off-street parking. Outside, the fully fenced yard offers room for pets, gardening, recreation and summer entertaining. The included greenhouse is ready for the gardening enthusiast or can easily serve as additional shed and storage space.

The location adds even more appeal, with quick access to Southwestern Boulevard, Milestrip Road, Route 219 and the NYS Thruway, making travel throughout the Southtowns and into Buffalo convenient. Shopping, restaurants, services and recreation are all nearby, with the Village of Orchard Park, Highmark Stadium area, Quaker Crossing and McKinley Mall corridor just a short drive away. A wonderfully maintained home in a quiet setting with the convenience Orchard Park has to offer!
